svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: One MCP call, end to end
svg.desc: An MCP client posts each JSON-RPC message to /mcp over HTTPS. A client that only speaks stdio runs ramen-mcp-bridge beside itself and sends the same message over gRPC instead; a plain gRPC client skips the bridge and calls ramen.v1.Mcp/Call on the same port. The bridge hop is plaintext HTTP/2 unless the client is given --tls or --ca. TLS terminates at the load balancer, which reads the ramen-group and ramen-zone headers and forwards to that zone's worker pod over cleartext HTTP/2 unless the node itself runs TLS. In the pod the Rust node checks the bearer key and the source range and hands the message to the Python runtime over stdio; the runtime loads the group's packages from the group bucket. Alongside, the console clones the group git repo, uploads it to the bucket on deploy, and calls the node directly on its pod IP for reload, metrics and health. Health checks answer through the load balancer with no key and no source-range check; server reflection is switched off on deployed workers.
